pet.drawerAppearancePlaceholder: e.g. black British Shorthair, medium build, white tip on the tail
pet.autoGenHint: Upload clear photos or a video and we'll write it
pet.poseGuide: Front, side and back work best
pet.speciesTip: Cats and dogs work best; other species are experimental and may be less accurate
pet.countHint: Up to 3 recommended (you can add more)
pet.videoNotMixed: Upload video separately, not with photos
pet.descriptionGenerated: Description ready — edit it and save
pet.noPetDetected: No pet found — try a clearer photo
pet.candidatesHint: {{count}} reference photos found; all will be saved (tap one to make it the avatar)
pet.candidatesHintAvatarOnly: No reference generated, so this is avatar-only. Use a clearer full-body shot to be recognized.
pet.refsInconsistentConfirm: These look quite different, maybe not the same pet — continue anyway
pet.addMaterialHint: Add photos or video from other angles to improve recognition
pet.noRefCropsToAppend: No pet outline found in these — try a clearer full-body photo

warn.species_mismatch: Species doesn't match the description — please check
warn.generic_look: No clear distinguishing features (pattern, breed, accessory) — may be hard to tell apart. Add clearer photos.
warn.refs_inconsistent: Photos look quite different — maybe not the same pet
warn.multiple_pets: More than one pet in view; the main one was picked. Upload others separately.
warn.partial_decode_failed: Some photos couldn't be opened and were skipped
warn.low_sharpness: Photos are a bit blurry — reference quality may suffer. Clearer is better.

pet.modelUnconfigured: No perception model yet — set one up on the Models page
pet.confirmDeletePet: Delete {{name}}? Its profile goes too. This can't be undone.
pet.observeTimeout: Timed out — the files may be large. Try again or use smaller ones.
pet.experimentalHint: Lets pets be listed as family members and called by name in descriptions. Turning it off only hides them; nothing is deleted.
pet.profilePetEmptyHint: Upload photos to auto-describe, or tap Edit
